claims.text: Role in SSc: reflux esophagitis: high-dose PPIs, frequent small meals, HOB elevation, not lying supine within 3 h of the last meal.
claims.quote: Reflux esophagitis is relieved by frequent small feedings, high-dose proton pump inhibitors, sleeping with the head of the bed elevated, and not lying supine within 3 hours of the last meal.

claims.text: PPIs are contraindicated w rilpivirine-containing prod.
claims.quote: Proton pump inhibitors (PPIs), including PRILOSEC, are contraindicated in patients receiving rilpivirine-containing products

claims.text: Omeprazole w MTX (mainly ↑dose) may raise and prolong MTX levels, possibly causing toxicity;
claims.quote: Concomitant use of omeprazole with methotrexate (primarily at high dose) may elevate and prolong serum concentrations of methotrexate and/or its metabolite hydroxymethotrexate, possibly leading to methotrexate toxicities

claims.text: a temp PPI hold may be considered w ↑dose MTX.
claims.quote: A temporary withdrawal of PRILOSEC may be considered in some patients receiving high-dose methotrexate.
